claim_en: THE SINAI-DETAIL RULE. Generalities and details of every commandment from Sinai, read off one place-name.
middah: I3 (the Sinai-detail rule — the sabbatical year's generalities and details from Sinai generalized to every commandment, read off one place-name; the received translation of 25:1 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE ONSET. Recognition of one's plot triggers the duty; the dated schedule from the crossing to year sixty-four; Onkelos's release before the LORD.
middah: plain (the onset — recognition of one's plot triggers the duty; the dated schedule from the crossing to year sixty-four; the received translation's release before the LORD, ink, beside)

claim_en: SIX AND SIX. Rooted before the New Year gathered in the seventh; the one-third threshold; the pairing arithmetic.
middah: E10 (the doubled six-years — rooted before the New Year gathered in the seventh; the one-third threshold; the pairing arithmetic; the received translation of 25:3 the ink leg)

source: Sifra, Behar, Section 1 4-6 + Chapter 1 1-2 + Onkelos Lev 25:4
claim_en: THE LABOR CENSUS. Every field and vineyard labor; the class rule by went-out-to-teach; the Jubilee outside the cycle; the thirty-day addition and the fruit lag.
middah: I8 (pruning and reaping singled out from every field and vineyard labor — went-out-to-teach, the class rule named; the Jubilee outside the cycle; the thirty-day addition and the fruit lag; the received translation of 25:4 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE CHANGED MANNER. Guarded no, ownerless yes; consumption in a changed manner; the land's clock and the fruit's clock; Onkelos's left-alone vine.
middah: plain (the changed manner — guarded no, ownerless yes; consumption in a changed manner; the land's clock and the fruit's clock; the received translation's left-alone vine, ink, beside)

claim_en: THE EATERS. Resting not guarded; the improved-field dispute with reversed attributions; the rich eat; the post-removal class disputed.
middah: plain (the eaters — resting not guarded; the improved-field dispute with reversed attributions; the rich eat; the post-removal class disputed; the received translation of 25:6 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE FIELD-CLOCK. The house follows the field; the export border; the season table with the tithe-season import; the quantities as data.
middah: plain (the field-clock — the house follows the field; the export border; the season table with the tithe-season import; the quantities as data; the received translation of 25:7 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE COUNT. The court counts; the two-verse pin; the seventh-Jubilee dependency disputed; Onkelos counts releases.
middah: plain (the count — the court counts; the two-verse pin; the seventh-Jubilee dependency disputed; the received translation counts releases, ink, beside)

claim_en: THE SHOFAR. Exported to the New Year with its three-part structure; every individual; Sabbath override everywhere at the Jubilee, court-only at the New Year.
middah: I2 (the shofar exported to the New Year on the shared 'seventh month' with its three-part structure; every individual; the Sabbath override everywhere at the Jubilee, court-only at the New Year; the received translation of 25:9 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE JUBILEE'S GATES. Release fires at Yom Kippur inside a year sanctified from the New Year; ceased with the exile of two and a half tribes; validity keyed to sending or blast; not to the former office.
middah: plain (the Jubilee's gates — the release at the Day of Atonement inside a year sanctified from the New Year; ceased with the exile of two and a half tribes, 'to all its inhabitants', E2, beside; validity keyed to sending or blast; the received translation of 25:10 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE TIMER'S END. Holiness to the year's end only; the seventh's labor ban imported whole.
middah: plain (the timer's end — holiness to the year's end only; the seventh's labor ban imported whole; the received translation of 25:11 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE SUBSTITUTION CHAIN. Holiness seizes the last payment while the fruit stays bound; the jar dispute with Rabban Gamliel's ruling.
middah: plain (the substitution chain — holiness seizes the last payment while the fruit stays bound; the jar dispute with Rabban Gamliel's ruling; the received translation of 25:12 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE TWO RELEASES. Money to the seventh, slaves to the Jubilee, both cross-inferences refused; the son's redemption returns to the father.
middah: plain (the two releases — money to the seventh, slaves to the Jubilee, both cross-inferences refused; the son's redemption returns to the father; the received translation of 25:13 the ink leg)

claim_en: OVERREACHING. Four exclusions; monetary here, verbal at 25:17; the sixth with R. Tarfon's third; the upper hand; coin thresholds; both parties.
middah: E2 ('from your neighbor's hand' — four exclusions: land, slaves, documents, the consecrated; monetary here, verbal at 25:17, M-23, beside; the sixth with R. Tarfon's third; the upper hand; coin thresholds; the received translation of 25:14 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE TWO-YEAR FLOOR. Not less than two produce years; blight and the seventh do not count; three harvests in two years.
middah: M-12 ('years of crops' — the plural's minimum, not less than two produce years; blight and the seventh do not count; three harvests in two years; the received translation of 25:15 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE HEART CLAUSE. Verbal wronging's cases; the fear clause marks unobservable intent.
middah: plain (the heart clause — verbal wronging's cases; the fear clause marks unobservable intent; the received translation of 25:17 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE AFTERGROWTH BAN. Torah (R. Akiva) or scribal (the Sages) — the provenance fork recorded.
middah: plain (the aftergrowth ban — Torah by R. Akiva or scribal by the Sages, the provenance fork recorded; the received translation of 25:20 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE YEAR LADDER. Three years in two readings; eighth to eleventh counted from the doubled tokens.
middah: E10 (the year ladder — three years in two readings; eighth to eleventh counted from the doubled tokens; the received translation of 25:21-22 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE LAYER LABEL ON THE LABOR CENSUS. The derivative labors are rabbinic with the verse a mere support; the four written verbs are the Torah's; plowing's lashes disputed on R. Avin's meta-rule; the pre-year addition in three layers (thirty days a halakhah, the cutoffs ordained and abolished, Temple-bound). Filed F-201, auto-seated (round 47).
middah: plain (the layer label on the labor census — the derivative labors rabbinic with the verse a support, the four written verbs the Torah's; plowing's lashes disputed on R. Avin's meta-rule; the pre-year addition in three layers (Moed Katan))

claim_en: SEVENTEEN JUBILEES AND THE DESTRUCTION'S CYCLE-YEAR. The cycle run against the chronology: seventeen Jubilees from entry to exit, the count begun fourteen years in, both houses' destruction years placed in the week under both recorded cycle models. Filed F-203, auto-seated (round 47).
middah: plain (seventeen Jubilees and the destruction's cycle-year — the cycle run against the chronology, the count begun fourteen years in, both houses' destruction years placed under both recorded cycle models (Arakhin))
